comment: Everything the union op packages are built from, pinned. Heavy trees are NOT committed; fetch.py provisions them into this directory and verifies every ref.

entries.name: ops-transformer
entries.note: must be the union fork: upstream/stepx refuses maskType!=1

entries.name: ops-nn
entries.purpose: UnionSparseMeta pre-processing op (NPU union + mask) and its torch-extension wheel

entries.name: cann-cmake
entries.purpose: build glue both op repos FetchContent from gitcode when the third-party path has no cann-cmake/; having it there is their offline entry point

entries.name: opbase
entries.purpose: op host/base framework; each op repo checks its own pin out in place

entries.name: ops-tensor
entries.purpose: tensor_api headers; carries include/tensor_api as a submodule
entries.note: the submodule commit differs per pin; fetch.py initialises it for every ref

entries.name: catlass
entries.purpose: tile-level GEMM templates the GBSA kernel includes (v2.0.0)

entries.name: ops-test-kit
entries.purpose: UT kit the op repos fetch
entries.note: upstream pins branch master rather than a commit; recorded as master on purpose

entries.name: cann
entries.purpose: CANN 9.2.0 toolchain, only for a from-scratch image build
entries.note: not needed with --reuse-base-assets, and not needed to build the op packages on a host that already has CANN
